Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Paul McGrath is credited on 117 distinct recordings across 5 programs from 1945-04-17 through 1974-02-03. Documented roles include host on 101 recordings and performer on 17 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Inner Sanctum Mysteries (host on 101 recordings and performer on 1 recording; 101 distinct recordings), Theater Five (performer on 10 recordings; 10 distinct recordings), The Chase (performer on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), Barrie Craig (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and CBS Radio Mystery Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include The Inner Sanctum Host (100 portrayals).
